# First

Gives the first element of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
First(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. The element at position 0. Null when items is empty or null, and when its first element is itself null.

## Example

`First([7, 8, 9])` returns 7.

`First([])` returns null.
